bio: Angelo Moraca was baptized Angelo Paolo on 10 February 1744 at San Mango D'Aquino, Catanzaro, Calabria, Italy, the son of Antonino Moraca and Teresa Sposata. His godfather was Gaetano Ferlaino, who is himself an ancestor of John. Angelo is John's 5th-great-grandfather.
